messages:
maya: heads-up: release/3.5.1 build pushed to gcr-eu failed publish check. deploybot blocked with `cosign: signature_expired`.
deploybot: blocked: provenance_validation_failed (cosign_signature_age > allowed_ttl). details: signed_at=1710000000, now=1742002222, ttl=2592000s
maya: whoa that's a big clock delta, signed_at looks months old. but build just ran.
ci-bot: fetch logs: ci/4001: build completed 1742002200; cosign step output: "signed ok"; cosign metadata shows signature_timestamp=1710000000 (from artifact metadata)
toni: sounds like we accidentally reused a cached layer or imported an older attested image into the manifestlist during our multi-stage builder.
archibald: could also be that the builder VM clock was wrong during cosign on arm64 runner. check runner clock in gce logs.
maya: rolling back to pinned 3.5.0 for prod if we can't get a clean publish before the change window closes.
release-manager: change window today 19:00-21:00 UTC. we can still do a staging-only patch outside that window if needed. prefer not to expand window.
toni: mitigation options: 1) remove old attestation footprint and re-sign freshly 2) rebuild that slice 3) override deploybot TTL check (dangerous)
maya: prefer 1 or 2. which is fastest?
ci-bot: option 1: re-sign existing digest -> requires cosign private key access and re-run attestation job; takes ~3-5m once key access confirmed. option 2: rebuild arm64 slice -> ~12-18m.
archibald: re-signning is okay only if the image digest is identical and we can prove the content hasn't changed. I think it's identical, but we should verify layer checksums.
maya: can we do a controlled re-sign to staging-only first?
release-manager: yes. plan: re-sign and push to staging registry mirror account with ephemeral tag `staging-release-3.5.1-resign`. do not promote to prod until canary 30m clears.
toni: I'll run checksums: `gsutil cat gs://ci-artifacts/4001/manifest.json | jq '.layers[].digest'` then compare to registry digests.
ci-bot: checksum verification: registry vs artifact store -> all digests match for amd64 and arm64.
archibald: good. proceed with re-sign. make sure to record the cosign key rotation id in release notes.
maya: re-sign job kicked: job-id `resign-221`. cosign sign succeeded at 1742002248.
deploybot: new publish attempt received; running provenance validation.
deploybot: publish to gcr-eu staging succeeded; manifestlist contains attestations with signed_at=1742002248.
maya: starting quick canary (10% traffic) to staging services. watching error rates.
ci-bot: canary metrics: 0.1% error rate, latency stable. health checks OK after 5m.
release-manager: unless we see regression in 30m, schedule prod promote at 19:30 UTC inside change window, otherwise rollback to pinned 3.5.0 digest.
toni: note for follow-up: add runner clock drift detection to CI preflight and add explicit cosign TTL enforcement during build step to avoid stale metadata reuse.
maya: adding release note: "Resigned image due to stale signature metadata on multi-arch builder; no code changes. Performed staging-only re-sign and canary before prod promote."
archibald: filing postmortem ticket with logs and CI runner audit.
release-manager: closing loop: if prod push goes green we mark this resolved; otherwise we execute rollback playbook.
maya: thanks all, will update when prod promote completes. :white_check_mark:
